title: Mental action is predictive control of effective connectivity

statements.text: Mental actions, such as deliberately focusing attention or building an argument, have no motor output and no sensory input to control. The proposal is that mental action is predictive control of effective connectivity, where what is predicted is the epistemic value of states in the self-model under counterfactual outcomes, accompanied and perhaps mediated by an epistemic agent model.

sources.quote: mental action is the predictive control of effective connectivity
In mental action there is no motor output to be controlled and no sensory input vector that could be manipulated by bodily movement.
